submitted.rationale: Of the 3 measured compositions, index 90 (Bi0.11 Cu0.52 V0.37) had the highest photocurrent, 4e-8 A. I chose the Cu-vanadate region because Cu vanadates absorb at 2.06 eV and BiVO4 does not. A little Bi looked like it might help, and going from 70 to 90 did raise the signal, but adding more Bi (110) did not.

rejected.reason: Measured about 0 A; low-Bi Cu3V2O8-like composition
Measured -3e-8 A; higher Bi, lower Cu gave no anodic photocurrent
